Allah swears by this city, Makkah.
And you, Prophet, live in this city.
And by the father and his children.
We created humans to go through effort and struggle in this life.
Does he think that no one has power over him?
He says: I spent a huge amount of money!
Does he think no one saw him?
Did We not give him two eyes?
And a tongue and two lips?
And show him the two ways, the good way and the bad way?
But he did not try to climb the steep road.
And what can make you know what the steep road is?
It is freeing a slave.
Or feeding people on a day of hunger.
Feeding an orphan who is a relative.
Or a poor person who has nothing.
And then being one of those who believe, and who tell each other to be patient and to be kind.
Those are the people of the right side.
But those who reject Our signs are the people of the left side.
Fire will be closed over them.
